title: Different answers leave hope freely open

captions.physics: Tying a possibility to identical wishes

meaning: You can preserve a hopeful perspective and feel different responses compatible while noticing a condition that hope requires identical wishes.
text: The Devil in the physical position of your Vishuddha can appear in tying a possibility to identical wishes. The Star in energy supports a hopeful horizon and continuation beyond present difference. Temperance in emotions brings compatibility between responses. You can welcome an idea and remain cautious about its form. One feeling need not cancel another, while a warm future is not established only through completely matching words.

For example, you suggest discussing earlier interests and hear interest in the subject but unreadiness to show old notes. You want to ask “Would it not be wonderful to remember everything together?”, linking the perspective with complete openness. **Hope can include different degrees of participation**. You can name the attraction and hear another readiness. Alignment appears when the subject stays available without compulsory supporting material. Neither enthusiasm need be hidden nor identical ease performed about every detail of the past.

Pressure returns if compatibility requires awkwardness to stop being felt. A welcome new perspective then merely conceals the earlier condition of complete agreement. The constructive Star helps keep the horizon open and varied. You can share an idea without sharing every form of it; compatibility requires no identical quantity of storytelling beforehand, while caution demands neither closing a subject nor proving the wish to continue insufficiently sincere.
